hero.subtitle: Rinda is a short, private check of six everyday health habits for young adults in Rwanda. You get a clear, explained result for each one, and real places to get help.

phone.step: About 20 more minutes of activity on 3 days

float.mood: Mood check-in, only if you want

features.title: Everything you need to understand your health
features.subtitle: No jargon and no judgement. Just your results, why they matter, and one thing you can do next.

checkup.title: A check-up in about ten minutes
checkup.body: Tobacco, alcohol, activity, food, body size and blood pressure. Skip anything you prefer not to answer.

results.title: Clear results, explained
results.body: Each area shows a word and an icon, never just a colour, with the reason in plain language.

steps.title: Small next steps
steps.body: Rinda picks the few areas to work on first and suggests one small, realistic change.

mood.title: Mood and stress, privately
mood.body: An optional check-in on how you have been feeling, shown on its own and never added to other results.

guide.title: Ask Rinda
guide.body: Tap a question and get your results explained in friendly words, from approved guidance.

offline.title: Works without internet
offline.body: Install Rinda on your phone. Check-ups are scored on the phone and sent when you are back online.

s1.title: Create a free account
s1.body: Use your email or phone number, or sign in with Google. Choose English or Kinyarwanda.

s2.title: Answer a short check-up
s2.body: Simple questions and a few measurements. Every question can be skipped.

s3.title: Read your results
s3.body: See each area explained, your next small step, and where to get help if you need it.

rwanda.eyebrow: Made for young adults in Rwanda
rwanda.title: Healthy habits start long before problems do
rwanda.body: Many heart and lifestyle conditions grow quietly through our twenties and thirties. Rinda helps you notice early, in your own language, and points you to real services in Rwanda.

privacy.title: Your answers belong to you
privacy.p1: No ads, no trackers, no selling of data.
privacy.p2: What you save on your phone is encrypted.
privacy.p3: You choose what to share, and can change it any time.
privacy.p4: Ask for your data to be deleted, and it is gone within 72 hours.
privacy.p5: "Get help now" is always one tap away.

about.title: Made for you, and for young people across Rwanda
about.body: Rinda is for young adults who want to understand their health without a clinic visit, a long form or any judgement. You answer a few simple questions, see where you stand in each area, and get one small step you can actually take. Your answers stay yours, and help is always one tap away.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No. Rinda is educational. It helps you understand everyday habits and tells you when it is a good idea to see a health worker.
faq.a2: Yes. Rinda is free, with no ads.
faq.a3: Only you see your results. Study staff see counts and masked names, never your answers.
faq.a4: Yes. After the first visit you can install Rinda. Check-ups done offline are scored on your phone and sent later.
faq.q5: What if I do not feel safe?
faq.a5: Tap "Get help now" at any time to see hotlines and services you can call straight away. Rinda is not an emergency service.
faq.a6: English and Kinyarwanda. You can switch at any time.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.body: Questions about Rinda or the study? We would love to hear from you.

cta.title: Ready for your first check-up?
cta.body: It takes about ten minutes, it is free, and you can stop at any time.

s1.title: Your health, explained in plain words.
s1.body: Six everyday habits, one clear result for each.

s2.title: Small steps you can actually keep.
s2.body: Rinda suggests one realistic change at a time.

s3.title: Private, free and in your language.
s3.body: English or Kinyarwanda, on your phone, even offline.
